entries.heading: SENSE OF CONGRESS REGARDING THE MARITIME INDUSTRY OF THE UNITED STATES
ancestors: DIVISION G—ELIJAH E. CUMMINGS COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2020
entries.text:
SEC. 8403. SENSE OF CONGRESS REGARDING THE MARITIME INDUSTRY OF 
                          THE UNITED STATES.

    It is the sense of Congress that the maritime industry of the United 
States contributes to the Nation's economic prosperity and national 
security.
